title: Run-Flat Does Not Mean Drive Normally Forever
topic: Run-flat tires provide limited emergency mobility after pressure loss
mechanicTruth: Run-flat tires are designed to provide limited mobility after pressure loss, subject to the specific tire and vehicle limits; they are not permission for normal indefinite driving while deflated.
